title: Base Read Discrete Inputs variant 6
purpose: Use a larger but conventional discrete-input quantity to exercise quantity decoding, response byte-count calculation, and packed-bit response parsing.

messages.label: Read Discrete Inputs request, unit 18, start address 0, quantity 16

expected_behavior: A conforming server should parse function code 02 and request 16 discrete inputs, producing a response with a two-byte packed status payload or a standard protocol exception.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches the six bytes after the transaction and protocol fields.
Function code 02, address 0000, and quantity 0010 are structurally complete.
The requested quantity maps cleanly to a two-byte packed response payload.
Hex is lowercase and contains no separators.
issue_safety_notes: No issue reports or external protocol documents were available; parser-depth intent is based only on model-prior protocol plausibility and does not assert a vulnerability.
